data.action: 站在全息投影前听简报
data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · C&C任务简报】千年科学学园秘密基地内，C&C 04号特工时伫立在全息作战投影前，金发编成利落的单侧公主辫，耳麦闪烁着微光。她冷静地向你敬礼汇报——「C&C 04号飞鸟马时，向主人汇报任务简报。本次作战无论目标是谁，时都会完美排除障碍……Peace Peace ✌️✌️。」
data.promptProse: Toki salutes before the holographic mission projection in the Millennium C&C base, her blonde side braid and headset framing a calm reporting expression. Her maid combat outfit and small armor panels remain in the low medium view. Projection layers occupy one side of the foreground and control equipment stands behind. Cool holographic light reflects on her headset and armored seams, with soft shade between the layered skirt folds.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · C&C任务简报
